owl:Class.rdfs:label: Material
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Substance used as the basis for manufacturing, testing, or analysis

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Polymer
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Macromolecule composed of repeating monomer units

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Plastic
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Material containing polymer, capable of being shaped by flow

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Polyethylene
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Polymer of ethylene, can be LDPE, HDPE, LLDPE, MDPE, or UHMWPE

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Polypropylene
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Polymer of propylene and copolymers with α-olefin units

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Polyester
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Polymer with repeating ester functional groups

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Elastomer
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Polymer with elastic properties returning to initial shape after deformation

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Composite
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Solid product with at least two distinct phases, such as a matrix and reinforcement

owl:Class.rdfs:label: TestSpecimen
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Piece of material prepared for use in a test

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Reinforcement
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Material, such as fibre, added to a matrix to improve mechanical properties

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Fibre
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Single textile element with small diameter and long length, e.g. glass, carbon

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Activity
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Process or operation performed on a material or product

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Property
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: A measurable or qualitative attribute of a material

owl:Class.rdfs:label: PerformanceProperty
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Property measured through tests relevant for application, e.g. strength

owl:Class.rdfs:label: TimeProperty
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Property related to time, such as curing, shelf life, or testing duration

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ViscosityProperty
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Property relating to viscosity, including dynamic, kinematic, or intrinsic viscosity

owl:Class.rdfs:label: EnergyProperty
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Property relating to energy values, such as impact energy, heat of combustion

owl:Class.rdfs:label: DeprecatedTerm
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Term marked as deprecated; replaced by new preferred terms

owl:Class.rdfs:label: CuringTime
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Time needed for curing process

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ShelfLife
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Time during which material retains working properties

owl:Class.rdfs:label: DurationOfTesting
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Time for test procedure, e.g. exposure or application time

owl:Class.rdfs:label: DynamicViscosity
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Viscosity corresponding to applied shear stress; in Pascal seconds

owl:Class.rdfs:label: KinematicViscosity
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Viscosity normalized by density

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ImpactEnergy
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Energy expended in breaking the specimen in impact testing; in Joules

owl:Class.rdfs:label: HeatOfCombustion
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Thermal energy produced per unit mass by combustion; in J/kg

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Moulding
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Process of shaping material in a mould by pressure and usually heat

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Testing
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Activity of investigating a property or performance of a material or object

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Thermoforming
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Process of shaping a heated thermoplastic sheet on a mould

owl:Class.rdfs:label: Welding
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Uniting softened surfaces of materials using heat and/or pressure

owl:Class.rdfs:label: AdhesiveBonding
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Joining surfaces using adhesive to achieve adherence or cohesion

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Indicates if a term is marked as deprecated

owl:ObjectProperty.rdfs:comment: Composite or material contains reinforcement component
Relates a material or object to an activity
Relates an Agent or Material to a performed activity
Property is measured by certain test

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Unit of measurement (provided as label string)
Data value range for a property

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ImpactStrength
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Energy per area needed to break a specimen under impact

owl:Class.rdfs:label: IzodImpactStrength
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Impact energy absorbed in Izod notched test per area; kJ/m2

owl:Class.rdfs:label: CharpyImpactStrength
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Impact energy absorbed in Charpy notched test per area; kJ/m2

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: afterFlameTime
owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Time for afterflame to persist; seconds

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: afterGlowTime
owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Time for afterglow to persist; seconds

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: meltFlowRate
owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Mass of thermoplastic extruded per 10 min; g/10min

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: GlassTransitionTemperature
owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Temperature at midpoint of glass transition, °C

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: TensileStrength
owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Maximum tensile stress during test; MPa

owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:label: VolumeFractionFibre
owl:DatatypeProperty.rdfs:comment: Volume ratio of fibres in composite; 0-1

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ColdGlue
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Deprecated term for cold-setting adhesive

owl:Class.rdfs:label: ColdSettingAdhesive
owl:Class.rdfs:comment: Adhesive that sets without application of heat
